reason: Why pay nearly ₹13,000 a year for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free and handle our two-person practice? Even though the July ITR and October ROC filing rush leaves me doing 10 PM annexure reviews in a panic over article clerk mistakes, in a normal week I cannot justify an annual subscription when our current routine costs zero.
objection: Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, and will article clerks actually follow these blueprints instead of me still having to review annexures at 10 PM?
would_change_my_mind: If testing the free 2-seat pilot during the October ROC rush proves that the maker-checker audit trail catches trainee errors and eliminates my late-night annexure reviews.
